description: a square [0,10]² less the quarter disc r 10 about (0, 10), extruded 10, cut by the box [8.5,0.5,4]–[9.5,1.5,6] inside it: the arc leaves the bottom edge at (0, 0) and meets the right edge at (10, 10) tangent to each, so every cap's loop turns back on itself there, a cusp. The cap's arrangement must turn once counter-clockwise: each cusp is a turn of +π round the spike, which the angle alone leaves to rounding. Shrunk from the battery of real/nist-ctc-04 and real/nist-ftc-06, whose plane faces bounded by blends tangent to a line have such cusps (ADR-0026 §4)
